messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Inspect** | Give the guitar a thorough wipe‑down, check for loose screws, cracks, or other damage. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and reduces buyer hesitation. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Use natural light, capture front, back, neck, headstock, sound hole, and any imperfections. | Good photos are the first thing buyers see; they can make or break a sale. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Look up similar models on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, and local music shops. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and gives you leverage during negotiations. | | **4. Write a Clear Description** | Include brand, model, year, condition, any upgrades, and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds trust and speeds up the process. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp.
• **Music‑specific sites** – Reverb, Musician’s Friend, Guitar Center (consignment).
• **Local options** – Garage sales, pawn shops, consignment at a local music store. | Different platforms reach different audiences; using multiple can increase exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point can still land you a good deal. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup** – safer, no shipping cost.
• **Shipping** – use a sturdy case, insurance, and trackable service. | Shipping adds risk and cost; local pickup is simpler but may limit your audience. | | **8. Handle Payment Securely** | • **Cash** – safest for local transactions.
• **PayPal** – offers buyer protection but watch for fees.
• **Escrow services** – for high‑value items. | Protects both parties and reduces fraud risk. | | **9. Negotiate Professionally** | Be polite, firm, and ready to explain your price. | Good communication can close the deal faster and keep the buyer happy. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Sign a simple bill of sale if you’re shipping, keep receipts, and confirm payment before handing over the instrument. | Provides legal proof of ownership transfer and protects you from disputes. | ### Quick Tips | Tip | How to Apply | |-----|--------------| | **Use a Case** | Even if you’re not shipping, a case protects the guitar during transport. | | **Offer Extras** | Bundling a strap, tuner, or cleaning kit can sweeten the deal. | | **Check Local Laws** | Some cities require a permit for selling certain items; double‑check if you’re in a regulated area. | | **Stay Safe** | Meet in public places for local pickups, bring a friend if possible, and never share personal info until payment is confirmed. | ### Resources | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | Reverb Pricing Guide | https://reverb.com/guide/pricing | | eBay Seller Center | https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter | | Facebook Marketplace Help | https://www.facebook.com/help/marketplace | | Consignment at Guitar Center | https://www.guitarcenter.com/consignment | --- #### Example Listing > **Title:** 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description:** > *Brand:* Yamaha > *Model:* FG800 > *Year:* 2015 > *Condition:* Light wear on the fretboard, no cracks, fully functional. > *Why Selling:* Upgrading to a 12‑string. > *Extras:* Comes with a hard case, strap, and a set of strings. > *Price:* $350 (negotiable). > *Pickup:* Local (Brooklyn) or shipping available. > *Payment:* Cash or PayPal. Feel free to adapt this template to your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice on selling an acoustic guitar. We need to provide guidance: listing online marketplaces, local classifieds, social media, consignment shops, etc. Also mention condition, photos, price research, shipping, safety. Provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, write description, choose platform (e.g., eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, Guitar Center, local music stores), set price, handle negotiations, shipping options, payment methods, safety tips. Also mention consignment or trade-in. Provide resources. No function call needed.
